name: DefinitionTooltip

props.name: align
props.description: Specify how the trigger should align with the tooltip

props.name: autoAlign
props.description: Will auto-align Definition Tooltip. This prop is currently experimental and is subject to future changes. Requires React v17+

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Specify whether the tooltip should be open when it first renders

props.name: definition
props.description: The `definition` prop is used as the content inside of the tooltip that appears when a user interacts with the element rendered by the `children` prop

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Specifies whether or not the `DefinitionTooltip` should open on hover or not

props.name: tooltipText
props.description: Provide the text that will be displayed in the tooltip when it is rendered.

props.name: triggerClassName
props.description: The CSS class name of the trigger element

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon DefinitionTooltip rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
